name: Skyscanner
description: Skyscanner flight search and fare comparison: place autosuggest (sky place ids and entity ids), live itinerary search by origin, destination, dates, passengers and cabin with airlines, durations, stops, fare policy flags and booking-source deep links, plus cached indicative fares per day and per month. Anonymous same-origin JSON APIs on www.skyscanner.com; live quotes and cached indicative prices are labelled as such; live quotes include the site's estimate of taxes and fees.

tools.name: Search flights
tools.description: Compare fares and itineraries for concrete dates. Resolve places with suggest_places first; use price_calendar or monthly_prices for cheap-date discovery instead of many live searches.

options.name: adults
options.about: adults

options.name: cabin_class
options.about: cabin_class

options.name: child_ages
options.about: One age per child (0-17).

options.name: currency
options.about: ISO currency the prices are quoted in. Pattern: ^[A-Z]{3}$.

options.name: destination_entity_id
options.about: Destination entity id (London city 27544008, LHR 95565050). Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,12}$.

options.name: inbound_date
options.about: Return date YYYY-MM-DD for a round trip; omit for one-way. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

options.name: market
options.about: Pattern: ^[A-Z]{2}$.

options.name: max_pricing_options
options.about: Booking options per itinerary, cheapest first (each carries a ~1 KB deep link); pricing_options_total tells how many the site has.

options.name: max_results
options.about: max_results

options.name: max_stops
options.about: Keep itineraries whose every leg has at most this many stops (0 = direct only). Omit for no filter.

options.name: max_wait_seconds
options.about: Maximum search time, including create, polling and waits. Polls every two seconds until complete, bounded also by the runner time and byte budgets. Returns partial results when a budget stops collection; an incomplete search with no itineraries returns upstream_unavailable. No automatic retries.

options.name: origin_entity_id
options.about: Origin city or airport entity id from suggest_places (New York city 27537542, JFK 95565058). Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,12}$.

options.name: outbound_date
options.about: Departure date YYYY-MM-DD (local date at the origin). Defaults to 30 days after the current UTC date when omitted. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

options.name: sort
options.about: best keeps the site's ranking; cheapest orders by price; fastest by total duration.

response.about: Live flight itinerary search for one-way or round trips: origin and destination entity ids, dates, adults, child ages and cabin class. Creates a radar unified-search session (POST /g/radar/api/v2/web-unified-search/), polls every two seconds until complete or its time/byte budget is reached (GET .../{sessionId}); returns itineraries with legs, segments, marketing and operating carriers, durations, stop counts, fare policy flags, the price in the requested currency and per-agent booking deep links, plus filter statistics. Sorting (best, cheapest, fastest) and the max_stops filter are applied to the whole result set client-side; the top max_results (of matching_results) are returned. Each poll delivers a full snapshot. There is no page cursor in this interface: raise max_results (up to 50) for more. A call is partial when matching_results exceeds returned or the search is still incomplete. HTTP and network failures are returned immediately without retries. Prices are live quotes from the moment of the poll and, as the site labels them, include its estimate of taxes and fees (taxes_and_fees = included_estimated). Each itinerary carries the cabin it is sold as (the requested cabin_class); the search payload states no per-segment cabin (segment_cabins = not_stated), which the site shows only in its itinerary-details surface.

fields.name: cabin_class
fields.about: Cabin the itinerary is sold as: the requested cabin_class, the only cabin the search payload states. The site's booking panel warns 'Although sold as X, this itinerary may include some flights with a different cabin class'; per-segment cabins are not available (segment_cabins).

fields.name: id
fields.about: Site itinerary id: leg ids joined by '|'.

fields.name: pricing_options_total
fields.about: How many booking options the site lists for this itinerary; pricing_options holds the cheapest max_pricing_options of them.

fields.name: tags
fields.about: Site labels such as cheapest, shortest, second_cheapest.

tools.name: Suggest places
tools.description: Start here to resolve a city or airport name into the identifiers the other functions take.

options.name: is_destination
options.about: Whether the place is being picked as a destination (the site ranks differently for origins).

options.name: locale
options.about: Locale for place names (en-US, en-GB, ...). Pattern: ^[a-z]{2}-[A-Z]{2}$.

options.name: market
options.about: Skyscanner market code (US, UK, ...). Affects ranking and place names. Pattern: ^[A-Z]{2}$.

options.name: query
options.about: Free text: a city, airport or country name, or an IATA code.

response.about: Flight place autosuggest: cities, airports and countries matching a free-text query, with the sky place id (LOND, JFK) used by price_calendar and the numeric entity id (27544008) used by search_flights and monthly_prices. Reads /g/autosuggest-search/api/v1/search-flight/{market}/{locale}/{query}, stateless.

fields.name: city_id
fields.about: Sky id of the containing city; null when the place is not inside a city (a country).

fields.name: entity_id
fields.about: Numeric geo entity id: input to search_flights and monthly_prices.

fields.name: geo_container_id
fields.about: Entity id of the containing city; equals entity_id for a city.

fields.name: iata_code
fields.about: IATA metro code for cities (LON); the site leaves it empty for airports, whose code is the place_id.

fields.name: phrase
fields.about: The site's display phrase, e.g. 'London Heathrow (LHR), London|England|United Kingdom'.

fields.name: place_id
fields.about: Sky place id (LOND, LHR, NYCA): input to price_calendar.

places.phrase: East London (ELS), East London|Eastern Cape|South Africa
